title: Sour Pancakes
description: A tangy twist on classic pancakes.
instructions: Preheat a non-stick skillet or griddle over medium heat.
In a large bowl, whisk together yogurt, eggs, and milk until smooth.
Add pancake mix to the bowl and stir until just combined.
The batter should still be slightly lumpy.
Using a 1/4 cup measuring cup, scoop the batter onto the skillet.
Cook for 2-3 minutes, until bubbles appear on the surface.
Flip the pancakes and cook for an additional 1-2 minutes, until golden brown.
